title: refactor(Formalism/SharpRestriction/GrowthBounds): generalize WeightWLet.ioBlock_wh and remove BFTrueDeg.ioBlock_wh'
body:
Generalize `Formalism.MainNotions.ColumnSystems.Pf.ioBlock_wh` in `WeightWLet.lean` to take a balanced weighted-homogeneity hypothesis directly (dropping the unused `mm` parameter), remove the duplicated `ioBlock_wh'` theorem and unused private imports from `BFTrueDeg.lean`, and update the call sites in `BFTrueDeg.lean`, `SymbolFormOfOrthogonality.lean`, and `SymFamilyWordEqHeadMulMonomial.lean`.

Removes `Formalism.MainNotions.ColumnSystems.Pf.ioBlock_wh'` from `BFTrueDeg.lean` and generalizes `Formalism.MainNotions.ColumnSystems.Pf.ioBlock_wh` in `WeightWLet.lean`.
